summary: Build and release Attachment Link Rules
description: Create a complete public Obsidian plugin repository, implement extension-based link/embed/default behavior for dropped attachments with test-first core logic, add local and community checker gates, prove it in the Windows-local test vault, create the public GitHub repository, and publish release 0.1.0.
acceptance: PDF defaults to a non-embedded link while common image extensions default to embeds.
Users can configure extension rules as link, embed, or default in a public-API-only settings tab.
The repository passes lint, typecheck, tests, build, community checker, completeness validation, and a Windows-local test-vault smoke.
A public GitHub repository and release 0.1.0 exist with exactly main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css as release assets.
